description: Defines the SongAdapter class for a RecyclerView in an Android music player app; manages how song items are displayed and handles user interaction to start the PlayerActivity on item click.

classes.name: SongAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of songs with album art, title, and artist; handles item binding and user clicks to transition to a player activity.

classes.name: SongAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: Holds references to the views for each item representing a song.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates item view layout and creates ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds song data to views and sets click listener to launch PlayerActivity if needed.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of songs.

methods.name: ViewHolder
methods.description: Initializes view references for a song item.
